title: Legal Framework
text:
Legal Framework
Learn more about our legal framework
In this section you can read more about our legal framework in Euronext Securities. As a financial market infrastructure, we provide services that ensure and facilitate a well-functioning capital market in both Denmark and the European Union. As such we are subject to comprehensive national and European regulation and supervision.
